purpose: Isolated generator evaluation for faithfulness and answer relevancy using ideal context.
notes: ideal_context contains pre-selected ground-truth document snippets to isolate generator testing from retriever performance.
expected_output represents the ideal grounded response.
Faithfulness evaluation checks whether generated actual_output is completely supported by ideal_context.
This dataset is used by evals/generator_eval.py with generate_from_context().

questions.question: What are the working hours and attendance expectations for full-time employees?
questions.expected_output: Full-time employees are regularly scheduled to work at least 35 hours per week. Standard business hours are Monday through Friday, 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM local time, with a one-hour unpaid lunch break.
ideal_context:
2.2 Employment Classifications
• Full-Time Employee: Regularly scheduled to work at least 35 hours per week.
• Part-Time Employee: Regularly scheduled to work fewer than 35 hours per week.

4.1 Working Hours and Attendance
Standard business hours are Monday through Friday, 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM local time, with a one-hour unpaid lunch break. Department-specific schedules may vary.

questions.question: How long is the introductory period for new employees and how is performance evaluated?
questions.expected_output: New full-time and part-time employees serve a 90-calendar-day introductory period starting on their start date. Performance and fit are evaluated by the employee's manager during this period.
ideal_context:
2.3 Introductory Period
All new full-time and part-time employees serve a ninety (90) calendar day introductory period beginning on their start date. During this period, performance and fit are evaluated by the employee's manager.

questions.question: What are the rules regarding gifts or hospitality from vendors or clients under the Conflict of Interest policy?
questions.expected_output: Employees must avoid conflicts of interest and are prohibited from accepting gifts or hospitality from vendors or clients valued above $100 USD.
ideal_context:
3.2 Conflicts of Interest
Employees must avoid situations in which personal interests conflict with Company interests.
1. Outside employment competing with Company duties.
2. Financial interests in a competitor.
3. Accepting gifts or hospitality from vendors or clients valued above $100 USD.

questions.question: How many annual PTO days do employees accrue based on their years of service?
questions.expected_output: Full-time employees accrue PTO based on service: 0–2 years get 15 days (1.25 days/month), 3–5 years get 20 days (1.67 days/month), 6–9 years get 23 days (1.92 days/month), and 10+ years get 25 days (2.08 days/month).
ideal_context:
4.2 Paid Time Off (PTO)
Full-time employees accrue Paid Time Off according to the following schedule:
Years of Service | Annual PTO Days | Accrual Rate / Month
0–2 years | 15 days | 1.25 days
3–5 years | 20 days | 1.67 days
6–9 years | 23 days | 1.92 days
10+ years | 25 days | 2.08 days

questions.question: How many days of unused PTO can be carried over into the following calendar year?
questions.expected_output: Unused PTO may be carried over up to a maximum of 5 days into the following calendar year.
ideal_context: Unused PTO may be carried over up to a maximum of 5 days into the following calendar year. PTO requests should be submitted at least two weeks in advance.

questions.question: What is the policy for paid parental leave following the birth or placement of a child?
questions.expected_output: Eligible employees receive 16 weeks of paid parental leave following the birth, adoption, or foster placement of a child, which can be taken continuously or intermittently within 12 months.
ideal_context:
4.5 Parental and Family Leave
Eligible employees are entitled to 16 weeks of paid parental leave following the birth, adoption, or foster placement of a child. Leave may be taken continuously or intermittently within 12 months.

questions.question: How many paid bereavement days are provided for immediate vs. extended family members?
questions.expected_output: Employees receive up to 5 paid days of bereavement leave for an immediate family member, and up to 2 paid days for an extended family member or close friend.
ideal_context:
4.6 Bereavement Leave
Employees may take up to 5 paid days of bereavement leave for the death of an immediate family member, and up to 2 paid days for the death of a extended family member or close friend.

5.4 Health and Welfare Benefits

questions.question: What are the 401(k) matching and vesting terms at Nexora?

questions.question: What is the remote work policy and core working hours requirement?
questions.expected_output: Eligible employees may work remotely up to 3 days per week with manager approval and must remain reachable during core business hours from 10:00 AM to 4:00 PM local time.

Eligible employees may work remotely up to 3 days per week, subject to manager approval and role requirements. Remote employees must maintain a secure workspace and remain reachable during core business hours (10:00 AM–4:00 PM local time).

questions.question: What are the password security requirements for company accounts?

questions.question: What are the requirements for using personal devices under the BYOD policy?
questions.expected_output: Personal devices used to access Company systems must be enrolled in the mobile device management (MDM) platform and comply with security requirements including passcode protection and remote wipe capability.

7.4 Bring Your Own Device (BYOD)
Personal devices used to access Company email or systems must be enrolled in the Company's mobile device management (MDM) platform and comply with minimum security requirements, including passcode protection and remote wipe capability.

questions.question: What timeline and process are involved in a Performance Improvement Plan (PIP)?

ideal_context:
8.1 Performance Improvement Plans (PIP)
Employees whose performance falls below expectations may be placed on a Performance Improvement Plan outlining specific, measurable goals and a defined timeline (typically 30–90 days) for improvement.

questions.question: What are the four steps of progressive discipline at Nexora?
questions.expected_output: The four steps are: 1) Verbal warning and documented coaching, 2) Written warning, 3) Final written warning and/or suspension, and 4) Termination of employment.
ideal_context:
8.2 Progressive Discipline
5. Verbal warning and documented coaching conversation.
6. Written warning placed in the employee's personnel file.
7. Final written warning and/or suspension, where applicable.
8. Termination of employment.
